full_page.content:
1935, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 14 July 10 Baby Catherine A. Sowersby - 3 mo. - quite under-weight - bright but ...
Neighbor of C. Sweeney ... last Nov. Miss Rose Mary Hines - 24 - discouraged - wayward Edw'd Collins Angeline - Deaf and Dumb .... improving
Page 15 July 11 Agnes Murphy - young L. four mo. out of work
12 John Zerilli - 23 - fell when a child and lost his mental balance .... Mother laments too that his father goes to holy Comm'n only once a year ....
Leo DeUriendt - 26 - fears cancer of stom. - indications point so. Has wife & Child.
Anthony Clancy - 24 - tuomers of stomach. ...
13 Joseph Raccuglia - 45 - threatened cancer on nose - has wife and three child'n. No Easter duty for three years. Enrolled To-day 50c promising to go to confession and enroll perpetually if
Winifred Gentner - 20 - accident last Nov. facial paralysis - promis- more frequent Com. and perpetual enrollment.
Mrs. Esterbrook see last week !!!
17
S. P. Gallagher - dying of cancer - away from Church years made peace with God.
Page 16 July John Zeller - 28 - hopelessly in H. P. Hospital ... Drs. would take off leg but patient too weak - 13 week sick.
Grace Mrs. Scoss - 46 - non Cath. - (colored)- A hernia and weak heart.
